sourceTitle: The Gladiators. A Tale of Rome and Judæa
description: "The Gladiators. A Tale of Rome and Judæa" by G. J. Whyte-Melville is a historical novel written in the late 19th century. Set against the backdrop of the Roman Empire and its interactions with various cultures, it delves into themes of power, sacrifice, and identity, primarily through the lens of its characters.
